name: Spikenaut-SNN
install:
set -euo pipefail
rustup show
cargo fetch --locked
cargo build --locked --all-targets
sudo python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r tools/anticipation/requirements-test.txt
julia --startup-file=no --project=tools/anticipation -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'
bwrap --version
bwrap --ro-bind / / --unshare-net -- /bin/true
